assignments.package_label: אֱמוּנָה — Faith Embodied in the Limbs
assignments.reason: This node ('when one has this kind of faith') describes the state of possessing embodied faith — אמונה so great it spreads through all the limbs. Its essential nature is אמונה itself: it is the condition of fully realized, body-permeating faith that the entire Torah #91 teaches. It belongs in Package 2 (אמונה) because it IS faith in its highest embodied form, not merely something that causes or is caused by faith. That it then leads (via eitza) to שכל/חכמה (Package 1) is the causal flow between packages, but the node's own nature is squarely in the domain of embodied faith.
